sources.notes: Complete ROM part/counterpart photographs personally inspected: broad continuous dark frond, strong axial zone, gently curved oblong outline, shallow angled lateral structures rather than independent protruding leaves; basal region irregular and blunt. Primary Hoyal Cuthill2022 Fig2 personally inspected: offset oblique lines around demarked axial band and texture continuing into inferred basal region, supporting cautious basal treatment. Color and living cross-section unpreserved. Thumbnail alone was inadequate and not treated as complete evidence.

sources.rights_note: Original generated concept used as design guidance only; not a primary factual source or texture.
sources.notes: Actual concept has correct connected narrow lamina and short blunt base, but is overly symmetrical and overregular. Retain continuous full-volume frond, subtly unequal lateral structures and low relief on both broad surfaces, sparse haphazard pustules on front only. Eighteen oblique structures each side as approximate about-three-dozen layout, not fossil-count assertion. No open negative spaces between structures: connected common sheet. Short basal attachment remains partly frond-like and blunt, not a big modern sea-pen bulb or plant roots. Rear has angled relief but no pustules. Thin solid cross-section, gentle bent pose, no rock slab or environment base.
